title: RoundResponse
description: What one round ended with: how the builder ended, the commit that holds the builder's work and the tests, its branch, and the declaration proof judges. No field holds a line of the tests.

built.description: How the builder ended, as built.json gives it.

outcome.description: The slice is written in its worktree.

oneOf.description: The builder stopped, since the slice needs a capability that is not there.

outcome.description: The builder stopped before the slice was done.

missing.description: What is missing: where it would live, and its name. No sentence, so nothing a builder writes reaches a card.

lacks.description: Where the missing capability would live.

name.description: The name of the missing function, operation or action, such as worktrees.commit.

head.description: The commit proof judges: the tests over the builder's work, in full.

branch.description: The branch the head is on, forge/<slice>-tests.

declared.description: The builder's declaration with the test files added, since the test writer declared them by handing them in.

tests.description: The paths of the tests the head holds; never their text.
